title: Audit actual QQ16 pair and exclude selected-only post-pair bridge repair
body:

A source-bound ordinary-port witness gives the next bridge output **0 versus +1/2**. This closes that narrow connection experiment; it is not a general QQ16 barrier or a cheaper supplier.

The package binds replica0 calls[0]/calls[4], intervening replicas and borrowed helpers, the pair1 idle transition, and execution6/source-event3's full signed bridge. It replays the actual #4015 decoder word on the 224-dimensional data specialization, distinguishing recovered original values from the caller's current values. It never inverts the private-clearing 712-field transition or identifies F0/B1's different helper banks (intersection40, union920).

For the declared independent-cover module input X0(d,z)=delta[d=I73], constant in payload, ordinary current Y1 is 0 under the selected pair and -1/2 under QQ16. Actual 73D owner products give `(D_(rho1 rho76)+D_(rho1 rho81))/4-I/2`; identifying cover owners falsely cancels this residual. The excluded adapter preserves ordinary pair0 fields, pair1 bridge inputs and other persistent bridge inputs. Earlier producer changes, repairs writing U, different proved endpoints and separately established reachable-state restrictions remain open. We have not proved this witness is generated by a particular outer multiplication input.

The literal candidate operation ledger identifies sixteen removed H8 centres and thirty-two introduced H1 lines. QQ16 pair versus selected pair adds 28,616 scalar allowance; appending #4015 adds 224 H1, 448 wrappers, 352 maps, 416 CLEARs and 26,944 scalar allowance. The raw subtotal is **+240 native calls, +128 native rank sum and +55,560 scalar allowance**, before a valid current-endpoint repair. These different units are kept separate. The decoder's 224 owned outputs, conditional terminal cleanup, general repair, physical placement/movement, precision and actual recursive usage remain unpaid or unproved.
